title: [CON2-5] Client conformance class leaves out the new identity flows (§2.6 to §2.8)
description: Review finding CON2-5: Client conformance class leaves out the new identity flows (§2.6 to §2.8) (lens CON2). Location: spec/01-overview.md:79. Fix: The Client row lists §2.1, §2.2 then jumps to §3.3. §2.6 holds "Members MUST accept an own-device Add" and the self-group MUST; §2.7 holds the `IdentityChanged` send/receive rules, the only re-resolve signal. §1.4 limits obligations to listed sections. Add "§2.6, §2.7, §2.8 (multi-device, identity change notice, account deletion)" to the Client row. Full text: notes/review2/CON2-verified.md and notes/review2/CON2.md.
